theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (β : Covector (Euclid P) n), 0 < r → ∃ (ϑ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Continuous ϑ ∧ HasCompactSupport ϑ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ϑ x ∧ ϑ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, ‖x‖ < r → ϑ x = 1) ∧ ∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = ϑ x • β
